order by created_at asc limit #{query.size} offset #{query.offset}

select from document_input_candidate where project_id = #{projectId} and external_requirement_id = #{externalRequirementId} and deleted_at is null order by created_at asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into document_input_candidate ( id, import_id, project_id, title, description, priority, acceptance_criteria, tags, status, source_ref, source_fragment, external_requirement_id, confidence, parse_source, model_invocation_id, model_provider_name, model_name, asset_requirement_id, error_message, ignored_reason, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{importId}, #{projectId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{acceptanceCriteria}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{sourceRef}, #{sourceFragment}, #{externalRequirementId}, #{confidence}, #{parseSource}, #{modelInvocationId}, #{modelProviderName}, #{modelName}, #{assetRequirementId}, #{errorMessage}, #{ignoredReason}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) on conflict (id) do update set title = excluded.title, description = excluded.description, priority = excluded.priority, acceptance_criteria = excluded.acceptance_criteria, tags = excluded.tags, status = excluded.status, source_ref = excluded.source_ref, source_fragment = excluded.source_fragment, external_requirement_id = excluded.external_requirement_id, confidence = excluded.confidence, parse_source = excluded.parse_source, model_invocation_id = excluded.model_invocation_id, model_provider_name = excluded.model_provider_name, model_name = excluded.model_name, asset_requirement_id = excluded.asset_requirement_id, error_message = excluded.error_message, ignored_reason = excluded.ignored_reason, confirmed_by = excluded.confirmed_by, confirmed_at = excluded.confirmed_at, version = excluded.version, updated_at = excluded.updated_at
mapper.select:
select from document_input_webhook_event
order by received_at desc limit #{query.size} offset #{query.offset}
select count(*) from document_input_webhook_event
select from document_input_webhook_event where id = #{id} and deleted_at is null

select from document_input_webhook_event where lower(source_code) = lower(#{sourceCode}) and deleted_at is null and ( (#{eventId} is not null and event_id = #{eventId}) or (#{idempotencyKey} is not null and idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}) ) order by received_at asc limit 1

select from document_input_webhook_event where deleted_at is null and status = 'FAILED' and signature_status = 'VALID' and raw_payload is not null and retry_count < #{maxAttempts} order by coalesce(processed_at, received_at) asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into document_input_webhook_event ( id, source_id, import_id, source_code, event_id, idempotency_key, event_type, event_version, signature_status, status, payload_digest, raw_payload, error_message, retry_count, replay_by, replay_at, replay_trace_id, received_at, processed_at ) values ( #{id}, #{sourceId}, #{importId}, #{sourceCode}, #{eventId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{eventType}, #{eventVersion}, #{signatureStatus}, #{status}, #{payloadDigest}, #{rawPayload}, #{errorMessage}, #{retryCount}, #{replayBy}, #{replayAt}, #{replayTraceId}, #{receivedAt}, #{processedAt} ) on conflict (id) do update set import_id = excluded.import_id, event_type = excluded.event_type, event_version = excluded.event_version, signature_status = excluded.signature_status, status = excluded.status, payload_digest = excluded.payload_digest, raw_payload = excluded.raw_payload, error_message = excluded.error_message, retry_count = excluded.retry_count, replay_by = excluded.replay_by, replay_at = excluded.replay_at, replay_trace_id = excluded.replay_trace_id, processed_at = excluded.processed_at

insert into document_input_retention_archive ( record_type, record_id, project_id, source_code, payload_digest, original_created_at, snapshot_json ) select 'IMPORT', i.id, i.project_id, i.source_code, i.raw_digest, i.created_at, to_jsonb(i) from document_input_import i where i.deleted_at is null and i.created_at < #{before} on conflict (record_type, record_id) do nothing

insert into document_input_retention_archive ( record_type, record_id, project_id, source_code, payload_digest, original_created_at, snapshot_json ) select 'CANDIDATE', c.id, c.project_id, i.source_code, i.raw_digest, c.created_at, to_jsonb(c) from document_input_candidate c join document_input_import i on i.id = c.import_id where c.deleted_at is null and i.deleted_at is null and i.created_at < #{before} on conflict (record_type, record_id) do nothing

insert into document_input_retention_archive ( record_type, record_id, project_id, source_code, payload_digest, original_created_at, snapshot_json ) select 'WEBHOOK_EVENT', e.id, null, e.source_code, e.payload_digest, e.received_at, to_jsonb(e) from document_input_webhook_event e where e.deleted_at is null and e.received_at < #{before} on conflict (record_type, record_id) do nothing
mapper.update: update document_input_candidate set deleted_at = coalesce(deleted_at, now()) where deleted_at is null and import_id in ( select id from document_input_import where deleted_at is null and created_at < #{before} )
update document_input_import set deleted_at = coalesce(deleted_at, now()) where deleted_at is null and created_at < #{before}
update document_input_webhook_event set deleted_at = coalesce(deleted_at, now()) where deleted_at is null and received_at < #{before}
